meta.description: Computer engineer focused on data science, machine learning, deep learning and computer vision: real-time UAV detection, GPS-free autonomous flight and applied ML.

hero.headline: I teach machines to see.
hero.focus: Data Science · Machine Learning · Deep Learning · Computer Vision
hero.intro: From real-time UAV detection with YOLOv8 to GPS-free autonomous flight on ROS2, I build vision and ML systems that work outside the notebook. I build full-stack web apps too.

about.label: About
about.title: Engineer by degree, vision nerd by choice.
about.bio: I graduated in Computer Engineering from Balıkesir University in 2025. Most of my work sits where data meets the physical world: detecting aircraft in a video stream, estimating a drone's position without GPS, or predicting clinical risk from patient data. I like taking a model from an idea to something that runs in real time.
about.now: Looking for ML, computer vision or data-science roles.

web.label: Web
web.title: Also building for the web
web.text: Before vision and ML, I built backends and web apps, and I still do. I use React and Next.js on the front end and Node.js, REST APIs, MySQL and Firebase behind them. This site is built with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind.
web.examples: TravelArt backend · Image Processor · Chat Sentiment App

contact.title: Let's build something that sees.
contact.text: I'm open to full-time roles, internships and freelance projects in ML, computer vision and data science. The fastest way to reach me is email.
